name: greymicroagent port policy

greymicroagent.port_block: 7640-7647: a dedicated range reserved for this product; verified free against other port policies and live listeners; below the Linux ephemeral range so the kernel never assigns it automatically
greymicroagent.model_file: ~/.greymicroagent/models/qwen3.5-2b-abliterated.gguf (Qwen3.5 2B text model; size and sha256 pinned)

other_families_off_limits.11600: cloud model service: direct calls only; no proxy or interceptor
other_families_off_limits.11434: retired local model port; do not reuse
other_families_off_limits.4444-4447, 4454-4457: historic ports from an earlier project; not claimed here

shared_local_infra.8888: local SearXNG search service (optional; used by the research stack)

rules: greymicroagent uses two live triples, (7640,7641,7642) and (7643,7644,7645), each a model:gate:slimtoken triple inside the dedicated 7640-7647 block, with 7646-7647 reserved for a future third session
a port occupied by anything else means a plain refusal or a documented direct fallback, never a fight
lanes filter their own upstream traffic only and never listen on foreign ports
cleanup stops only processes started by this session; it never uses name-pattern sweeps
